title: HD Admin Panel
features:
-- PAGE 1 --
- anticrash
- anti mute
- anti death
- remove all blurs
- anti jail
-- PAGE 2 --
- get many gears as possible
- get all periastrons
- Doge army
- Meteors
- Goner

-- NOTES --
note: this is only for HD Admin, the script is supported for the ranks,
Admin,
HeadAdmin,
Owner.

- UI Gradient

- Added goner (char may not work on other games)
- Changed the script so it does silent commands (will revert if hd admin removes the silent remote)
